description: This file is a shell script used for managing kernel modules during system startup. It loads modules listed in configuration files such as /etc/modules and /etc/modules-load.d/*.conf, ensuring module dependencies are met and handling module load commands.

methods.name: process_file
methods.description: Reads a module configuration file and loads listed modules if they are not already loaded, invoked for /etc/modules and configuration files in /etc/modules-load.d/
